name: Haldi doodh (turmeric milk)

source.name: Swasthi's Recipes (indianhealthyrecipes.com)
source.license: Ingredient amounts as listed in the cited recipe, converted to grams; nutrients composed from USDA FoodData Central (CC0)

notes: Serves 1. 1 cup whole milk 244 g; 3/4 to 1 tsp turmeric taken as 2.7 g; 1/8 to 1/4 tsp black pepper 0.4 g; optional 1 tsp sugar 4 g included; optional 1/8 tsp cardamom 0.3 g and 1/8 tsp cinnamon 0.3 g included; dry ginger and clove left out. No water; about 5% lost as steam while simmering.
